simple.summary: יָחַד (yâchad) means to be (or become) one First listed occurrence: Gen 49 6.

definitions.full: H3161. yachad [ יָחַד ] verb be united (Arabic be alone , II. make one ; Late Hebrew Pi`el יִחֵד make or declare one ; Aramaic יַחֵד unite , set alone ) — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular Gen 49:6 כְּבוֺדִי אַלתֵּֿחַד בִּקְהָלָם in their assembly let my glory not be united (|| נַפְשִׁי תָּבאֹ אַלֿ בְּסֹדָם ); 2 feminine singular Isa 14:20 בִּקְבוּרָה אִתָּם תֵחַד לֹא . Pi`el Imperative Psa 86:11 שְׁמֶ֑ךָ לְיִרְאָה לְבָבִי יַחֵד unite my heart (i.e. concentrate its affections, compare Jer 32:39 ) to fear thy name (but ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Gr Bi Ch יִחַדְּ (from חָדָה ) let my heart rejoice , etc.)
